messages.text: Aunt Katherine, did the little March file open on the laptop after the update?
It did. I put in the Publix and CVS slips from the white envelope and the balance matched my register.
Good. If it asks about saving to OneDrive, just pick the same folder as February.
Thank you. I want it ready before my middle-of-the-month paper pile shows up.
I am going past Building C after breakfast. Want me to turn the porch pots so they get the morning light evenly?
Yes, please. The fern by the slider gets lopsided, and the small violet in the guest room window needs a quarter turn too.
I can do both. I still have your spare key from the storm checklist envelope.
Thank you. The hallway door sticks a little, but once you are inside everything should be quiet.
Coffee after the walk? Also, Pete from bridge asked if you were coming to the Friday music night.
The library has that evening talk Thursday. Do you still want to go after our short walk?
Coffee yes. Friday music is fine if he knows I am driving myself and coming home to my own quiet place afterward.
Yes. I put a hold on Jesmyn Ward's book too, so I would like to hear the discussion.
I will tell him. You do like your own chair, your own thermostat, and your own morning routine!
Good. I also clipped the Palm Beach Post piece about the city meeting. We can talk over coffee first.
Exactly. There is room in my week for walking, church pantry, Emily's children on FaceTime, and dinner out now and then.
That sounds better than trying to sort it out in a crowd. Coffee and careful listening first.
Linda asked if you still want us to stop at Dune Deck when we come down Saturday.
Let's just do sandwiches here. I have tuna, rice, and those canned tomatoes with basil to make a decent supper.
That is fine. Do you need anything from Jacksonville before we leave?
No, thank you. I am leaving the shoe store errand for April and keeping Saturday simple.
Aunt Katherine, did the reunion pictures I tagged you in show up on your page?
Aunt Katherine, on that online intake page, there are two separate ancestry screens. Need me to walk you through them?
Yes please. I clicked no on the first origin question, then chose the plain European-family box on the next screen. The wording always makes me second-guess.
I saw the ones with Emily's children once I opened the blue F. I saved two to show Robert Sunday.
That sounds right from what you have told me. There is also a page asking for branch, dates, and discharge papers.
Good. I also sent the restaurant clip in the other app, but no rush if you don't open that one.
I left that whole page blank. Nothing to put there except Dad's old photo album, and that was his story, not mine.
That little camera app gets away from me. If it matters, send it here or put it where the family pictures are.
Aunt Katherine, if the white birds keep coming out too bright, tap the bird on the screen and slide the sun down a little.
Aunt Katherine, I found that old Florida list in my notes. You had Miami, St. Augustine, and one farther down the Keys circled.
That helps. The egret by the canal looked like a white sheet this morning.
That sounds like me. I keep coming back to Vizcaya and that big Fairchild place when I look at Miami.
Send me one before you put it anywhere. I can tell you if it needs cropping.
Want me to send you a simple map with driving times? The Miami stops are close, but St. Augustine is its own little trip.
I may use one later in the month. I have not put anything up since Linda's birthday note.
Yes, please. If there is a shady walking route at Fairchild, mark that one.
Are you still going to the clubhouse coffee after the walk? They moved the ballot machine demo to 10:15.
Yes. I want to see the mail envelope instructions myself. Too many forwarded posts make it sound crooked before anyone even reads the rules.
Good idea. I am bringing my questions about the library board item too.
Please do. The library should be for everybody, not a place for neighbors to shout over one another.
Are you still going to the clubhouse note-taking meeting Friday?
Yes. I wrote down the questions about written procedures, camera footage, and who reviews complaints when someone is hurt.
Good. I only know the usual parking lot calls here, so I would rather hear it plainly.
Same here. My own encounters have been mild, and that is not the whole picture.
If we stop overnight on the 20th, will the kids fit in your back room?
Yes. I just need to move the cutting mat off the side table and stack the blue-florals and red-strips bins under the window.
No rush. They can use the sofa too if your projects are spread out.
The bed is clear. I only have the green block and a basket of gray yarn on the chair right now.
Maya has her recorder thing at 6:15 and Lucas has soccer right after. If we hop on around 7:40, they can both wave before bed.
7:40 is fine. I will put the iPad on the stand so I can see everyone at the table.
Perfect. I will send the FaceTime from my phone once homework is packed.
Tell Maya I found the cookie recipe card she asked about. I can hold it up tonight.
Aunt Katherine, did you see that post going around about the new booster? Half the school office is sending it to each other.
I saw enough of it to close it. I am going to ask Dr. Singh's nurse tomorrow and look at the CDC page before I decide anything.
That sounds more sensible than our office group chat.
Publix also said their pharmacist can pull up my dates if Dr. Singh wants them.
Humidity looks decent. Full loop at 7:30 and coffee after?
Full loop is fine, and I can split a muffin. After lunch I am leaving the phone in the kitchen and reading.
Good plan. Clubhouse cards are tonight too, but that may be too much in one day.
The walk and coffee will do it. If the apartment feels too still after supper, I will send Elaine a porch wave.
Are you still stopping at the library after coffee Friday? Doris asked me if you had the March pages marked.
Yes. I put little slips at the Charleston chapters so I can find my notes quickly.
Good. She was carrying that thick Civil War one again and said you two were comparing endings.
That sounds like Doris. I also want to ask whether anyone has read Viola Davis for a later month.
Do you still have Mom's old red book with the penciled notes beside 88 and 140?
Yes, wrapped in tissue with the Camden certificate and the Cherry Hill class photos.
Linda asked because she is making the memorial booklet for Aunt Ruth.
Tell her I can copy the page with Mother's alto line, and I will bring a casserole for the table afterward.
Sunday call may need to be closer to 3:15. The Jags are not on, but Miami has the late afternoon slot.
That works. I can talk before kickoff and still have the 11 o'clock half-hour shows waiting afterward.
You still watch those after the games?
Only when the score leaves me too keyed up. The same old kitchen and sofa jokes settle the house down.
Aunt Katherine, did the PDF I sent open on your laptop or only on the phone?
It opened on the laptop. I printed the two pages and put them beside the county sheet. Easier to mark in pencil that way.
Good. The library printer would have worked too, but home is simpler.
I still like having the library there for people who need it. I will keep the pages clipped until I fill the envelope.
I gave the long box by your door a light drink. The mint perked up after that sun yesterday.
Thank you. I used a little rosemary on the potatoes, so that pot may look uneven.
It looks fine. I turned the rose pot a quarter turn so the back side gets some light.
Good thinking. I will leave the small blue can out before I go to Emily's.
Humidity is already sticky. Want to do the short loop and sit for coffee after?
Short loop sounds right. I was looking for an excuse to stay home, so thank you for checking.
I will be on the bench near the east doors. I saved you the shady side.
Leaving now. Save half that muffin idea for me too.
I am heading to the clubhouse at 8. Do you want me to leave the low-sodium crackers by your door?
Yes, thank you. I am writing down my morning cuff number first, then I will come over.
No rush. Bring those folded pharmacy pages if you want another set of eyes on the tiny print.
I put them in my tote with the refill receipt. I also skipped the salty soup last night.
Are you still going over to the clubhouse at 10? I can bring the extra pens.
Yes. I copied the names onto the clipboard last night and put it by the door with my white cardigan.
Good. I will meet you in the lobby at 9:50 so neither of us has to rush.
Thank you. I will check Mrs. Ito's row first since she said her hand bothers her when the line gets long.
Did the tire place treat you fairly? I hate surprise car bills.
It came to $400 even. I moved it from the side account and wrote it down.
Ouch. Coffee after Monday walk still okay?
Coffee yes, muffin no. I am making March a little lighter so April starts clean.
Before our Sunday call, do you want me to compare the Part D numbers with you again?
Yes, please. I have the bank page printed with the 3rd-of-the-month credit circled and the little Vanguard amount penciled in.
Good. Bring last year's tax folder too. Mine had two extra forms this time.
Mine is thin: the bank interest page, the January benefit statement, and the Vanguard form. Nothing from an office or payroll service.
Aunt Katherine, do you still put celery in the soup before the carrots? Mia asked because hers got mushy.
Celery first, carrots later. I made a pot Friday and kept enough back for Monday lunch.
That makes sense. Also send me the biscuit note when you find it, but only if it is easy.
I will. I cut that batch small now, so the recipe card has my pencil marks all over it.
Coffee after the short loop? I can bring the blank volunteer forms Gloria left on the front desk.
Yes, thank you. I want to mark the spots where people sign so no one feels foolish asking.
Good idea. Also bring that little black pen you like for the backs of pictures.
Already in my tote with the cranberry bread card and the photo of the Maple Avenue porch.
Dolphins replay is on later, but 4 still works for me.
Good. I will settle in with my tea before then.
Linda said to tell you the azaleas finally opened after all that rain up here.
Tell her I want a picture when you two get back from the store.
Do you still want to compare retirement expenses before our call? Linda says I should make a cleaner list this year.
Can we do our call closer to 4:30 today? Dolphins replay starts at 3.
4:30 is fine. I need to sort my notes for Tuesday anyway, the holds slips were a tangle last week.
Yes. Mine is short after the usual building draft: county estimate, wind policy, electric, and Dr. Moreno's $62.
You still help people with those public computers too?
Are you still thinking about coming up for my birthday lunch, or should Linda and I plan to come south?
Mostly passwords, printing, and finding the right shelf. Also reminding Dana I can come early if the memoir talk needs extra chairs.
I am checking the drawer stash after church. If gas and the turnpike look reasonable, I can do a daytime run.
That is a lot simpler than mine. I will call after the Dolphins replay ends.
Still good for our call after the Dolphins replay?
Fine. I will keep the folder open on the table so I can read the numbers instead of guessing.
No pressure. I do not want you pushing that long stretch if your legs are giving you trouble.
Yes. I just finished the March envelopes, so I can talk without papers spread all over the kitchen.
That is why I am looking at one stop each way and leaving before the glare gets bad.
Bring your Medicare numbers if you want to compare. Linda said our supplement notice jumped again.
I marked mine in pencil. The condo fee and light bill cleared first, then I checked what was left for the pharmacy and groceries.
I can call before the game starts if that is easier.
That would be good. I already looked at the bank app and the rain map, so I am putting the phone down after supper.
Fine by me. I will ring you in a few minutes.
Perfect. I changed the television to the old movie station before it got too loud in here.
I am taking the elevator down at 8:20. Want to do the short loop before it gets sticky?
Yes. The short loop is enough today. That easy morning schedule is still one of the best parts of picking this place.
Bring your hat. Also, the clubhouse board wants old community photos for the March table if you have any.
I only have the Cherry Hill ones out right now, with the little brick houses and church supper tables. I will look after we walk.
Channel 5 moved that cone a little east. Do you want me to come by after supper and look at the flashlight drawer?
Yes please. I checked batteries twice and still keep opening the pantry to count water bottles.
We will make one list and then close the cabinet. I still have the contact sheet from last year.
Thank you. I do better with a list than with my head running from windows to insurance to Robert's phone number.
Aunt Katherine, for the scrapbook page, should I put the Cherry Hill house picture before or after the school program?
Before, please. That porch picture was from the years when Robert still had that little bike in the driveway.
Got it. I can label the program 'Cherry Hill High, 1968' and then put the library desk photo next.
Yes, that order makes sense. I went from one folder to the next pretty quickly that summer.
It is already sticky out. Do you want the canal loop or just the shaded half?
Humidity looks decent. Full loop at 7:30 or just the short path?
Shaded half, please. My right knee is grumbling and I do not need to prove anything before breakfast.
Full loop is fine. I need to be at Ocean Breeze by 10 to fix the Tuesday and Thursday desk names.
Good. We can still get our steps and split a muffin after.
Good. Coffee after, but quick. I can help you sort the muffin halves and those little number cards if they are still in a mess.
Thank you. I also have to call Bea about switching her Friday afternoon spot before the new list gets copied.
Perfect. I will bring the small towel and meet you by the clubhouse bench.
The kids want to show you their school projects. Would after dinner work, maybe 7:15?
7:15 works. I had Mah Jongg yesterday and Marlene tomorrow, so today I kept 1 to 4 for sorting photos.
That sounds perfect. I will get them through homework first and call you from the tablet.
Lovely. A few minutes with their voices before the news will be just right.
Did you make it out before the heat today, Aunt Katherine?
I did. Marlene noticed I was dragging and matched my pace all the way around.
That sounds like Marlene. I am glad she keeps an eye out for you.
She also made me laugh over coffee, which helped more than the breeze.
I may call Sunday closer to 5. Dolphins replay is on earlier.
That is fine. I am walking to the clubhouse box after lunch anyway, then I will be home.
Same folder you use every time?
Yes, county sheet, League guide, Medicare notes, and the school tax article all clipped together. Slow, but it keeps me honest.
Checking in from Atlanta between meetings. You doing okay after all that rain?
Doing all right. Elaine looked at the patio for me, and I am drying the towels now.
Good. Did the Zoom link from Emily open on your iPad last night or did it ask for that code again?
It opened after I tapped the blue camera square. I could hear the little voices before I saw the picture.
Aunt Katherine, the link I sent should open the county page. The article is under Local, not Opinion.
Found it. Thank you. I wanted the full meeting notes before I say anything to Marlene tomorrow.
Makes sense. Also, if the library site asks for your card number again, send me a screenshot.
I may. I am trying to renew Heavy before the book group list changes.
Aunt Katherine, did the phone save the cuff readings after I changed that setting?
Yes, it made a neat little list. I showed it at the desk after my Wednesday class.
Good. And no more marathon walks in that Florida soup, okay?
I kept it to the short loop today. Slow and steady is winning this month.
The kids asked if your tomato sauce had the same green leaves from the pot by your chair.
Mostly basil, and a tiny bit of mint if I have clipped it that morning.
That explains why mine never tastes the same. Are the little roses still hanging in there?
Yes, Elaine shifted them toward the softer sun, and I think that helped.
For the memoir page, should I label the tiny brick building photo as Camden or Cherry Hill?
Camden for the earliest one. Cherry Hill is where Robert and I remember the Sunday shoes, the choir folders, and Dad waiting by the side door.
That helps. The kids loved the story about everyone being quiet until the organ started.
That was our household. Breakfast cleared, collars straight, then the familiar music.
Still walking at 7:30? Humidity looks kinder today.
Yes, but I may do the shorter loop. The old sneakers are rubbing again.
We can skip coffee after if your feet are tired.
Let's skip it today. I have tomato soup and half a box of pasta waiting at home anyway.
Coffee after the short loop? I want to compare notes from that clubhouse session.
Yes. I keep thinking about Mrs. Jenkins saying her grandson saves every receipt and route on his phone.
That stuck with me too. My grandkids complain about homework, not planning a drive that carefully.
Exactly. It made my own two or three easy roadside conversations feel like a very small sample.
My old coworker keeps talking about a fund that jumps around a lot. Says I am missing out.
At our age I would rather take the slow little gain and not watch numbers bounce at supper.
That sounds like you. Did you still do your first-of-month review?
Yes. Six months on the paper pad, plus the small Vanguard line. Good enough for me.
How are you doing, Aunt Katherine? Did the phone save the photo of your notebook page?
It did. I sent Dr. Patel the week of cuff numbers and the list from the pill bottles.
Good. For the scan, hold it flat near a window. The small print from the pharmacy bag should come out clearer.
That helps. One page says to ask before stacking it too close to my spring shot, so I circled that.
The condo page has a notice about parking lot lights tonight. Did you see it?
Yes, it was right above the orchid question in my garden group. I wrote down 7 to 9 p.m.
Perfect. My granddaughter posted it on X too but I knew you would catch the condo page faster.
You know me. I still look where the neighbors and plant ladies write in plain sentences.
HOA contact sheet is due Monday. Do you want me first again, then Robert and Emily?
Yes, please. Same order. I keep the kitchen copy by the phone and the travel copy in my purse.
Good. I can water your porch plants when you go to Tampa, too.
Thank you. I will only be gone one night, and the condo should stay simple while I am away.
Aunt Katherine, did you want me to scan those forms when I stop by next month?
That would help. There are only a few: the January letter, bank interest, and the Vanguard one. No stacks like you have from school.
Ha, I wish mine were that simple. I'll bring my little scanner.
Thank you, sweetheart. I also wrote down when the regular check hits so I don't move anything extra unless I need it.
Aunt Katherine, Mom loved the porch hibiscus picture you sent me. The red really came through.
I took six and only one was not blurry. I am keeping that one for my March share.
That one would be nice. The kids also want to see the blue quilt when the border is on.
I will try it by the patio door where the light is better, then maybe use that for Sarah's birthday note.
If Dad forgets to ask Sunday, can you remind him I need Linda's old pound cake pan measurements?
I will write it by the phone. We usually get to kitchen news after his yard report.
Perfect. They are supposed to drive back from Jacksonville Beach before then, so he should be home.
The kids have soccer Saturday morning, but Sunday lunch in Tampa would make them so happy if it works for you.
Let me count what is in the blue sleeve before I promise. I also need a place with easy parking and no steps.
I can pick a cafe right off Dale Mabry with a flat entrance. We can keep it short too.
That helps. If I come, I will leave early and be home before dark.
Do you want the short loop after your Publix stop, or should we just meet for coffee?
Coffee is better. They set aside my flu shot paperwork and the pharmacist said she would print my shingles dates too.
Good. Bring the papers and I will save us the table by the window.
Thanks. I also want to ask her about that scary link someone posted last night before I worry over it.
Are you still bringing something for the senior center table Monday?
I have two potholders finished and one small lap throw if I can get the binding corners neat.
Good. Put my name on one potholder if there are extras!
I can set one aside for you. The lap throw is going straight into the church box after coffee.
Senior center room B is open Tuesday. Want to sit together for that speaker on storm insurance and sea walls?
Yes. After last season I want people in office who read the weather reports and don't pretend the water is someone else's problem.
Agreed. I am also tired of folks dodging simple questions.
That matters to me more than it used to. I can disagree with a person, but I want a straight answer and a peaceful count when voting is done.
For Emily's family chart, put Mom as born in Camden and Dad in Trenton. I found the old church envelope.
Good. I only had Cherry Hill written beside their names and did not want to guess.
Do you want me to add Grandpa Holder's Maine line and Grandma's Pennsylvania line too?
Yes, and keep my section simple. No overseas addresses, no branch dates, just school, work, retirement, Florida.
Aunt Katherine, can you send me the porch photo again? The attachment was tiny on my phone.
I will try. I wrote 'Maple Avenue, 1962' on the back, but I still need you to tell me which cousin is standing by the steps.
Looks like Uncle Robert on the left. The smaller boy may be Tommy. Also, the scan button is the blue one at the bottom.
Found it. After lunch I am taking two copies to the center because Mrs. Larkin wants to practice sending hers to her son.
Aunt Katherine, did the new camera app find your living room window glare problem?
It did. I tested it from the kitchen, then from the little room where I keep the printer and the plant shelf.
Good. Keep it aimed at the entry, not the plants. Motion alerts will be cleaner that way.
That makes sense. The only movement most afternoons is the palm fronds by the balcony door.
Coffee after the walk? I can do the short loop first. Humidity is already rude.
Short loop and coffee sounds right. I stayed up for the last quarter and then let those two back-to-back apartment episodes run.
So you will need the muffin half with more cinnamon.
Please. That missed free throw at the end did not help.
Coffee after the short loop? Bakery has peach cobbler cups today.
Coffee yes. I may split one with you, no extra whipped top for me.
Deal. I will save us the corner table.
Good. I have a pan in the oven later and need to leave room for supper.
Coffee after Monday walk? The cafe raised the muffin price again!
Coffee yes, muffin maybe split. I paid the water and insurance drafts this morning and want the grocery list to behave.
We can split one. I have a coupon in my purse.
Perfect. I am not in trouble, just keeping the little leaks from becoming big ones.
The center posted Monday's kitchen table list. Did you get your slot?
I wrote myself in for 9:30, before coffee. I also put my tan pants and blue top on the chair since I have the dentist first.
You always remember the little things. I will take the 10:15 spot after our shorter walk.
That works. I can stay until you arrive, and then we can split a muffin.
I found that old Cherry Hill address card. Dad wrote both of our names on the back in his block letters.
Save it. Emily is trying to keep the names straight, and Mom's handwriting is hard to read in the photo margins.
There is also a clipping from your school ceremony. Mine is tucked behind it, probably because I was always three years behind you.
That sounds like our house. Everything in one drawer, with my papers on top and yours underneath.
We can still talk before the game tomorrow. Linda says I am following the cardiology instructions.
Good. I had your appointment circled on my calendar and kept thinking about it when I should have been balancing my checkbook.
I found Dad's picture from the Cherry Hill block picnic. The one by the split-levels.
Send it when you can. Emily asked for names, especially from the Sunday school picnic table.
Bills can wait until Monday. Mine got sorted once I stopped reading the same envelope three times.
I know. I also do not want you and Emily having to straighten out my papers someday, so I keep making piles.
Will do. Do you still have that folder from when you compared Jacksonville, Tampa, and Boynton?
Yes, with the 2014 notes. Doctors, condo fees, and being close enough for family visits were all on one yellow pad.
Can we do Sunday at 4:30 instead? Dolphins replay is on at 4.
4:30 is fine. I will have the bank website and my little notebook finished before lunch anyway.
I still write mine down too. Linda says I trust paper more than the computer.
Paper first, then I copy the totals to the March page. The receipt envelope is already getting thick.
Your hibiscus has two new blooms this morning. I gave it a little water while I was out front.
Thank you. The patio light is perfect before it gets too strong.
You would like the white birds by the canal today. One stood there like a statue.
That is exactly the sort of thing I hope to see if I get down to Fairchild.
I left your mail inside. Doris called while you were at Publix and said she found the old Paris one you wanted.
Thank you. That must be the one set around the 1939 exhibit. I wanted to compare it with our April stack.
She also asked if you still have the Viola Davis copy with the yellow sticky notes.
I do. It is on the kitchen chair so I remember to bring it back.
Dolphins replay starts at 4. Can we talk at 3:15 instead of our usual time?
3:15 is fine. Church coffee this morning was plenty, and I am keeping the rest of the afternoon slow.
If I get pulled into the game and miss you, call me after your supper plate.
I may do that. On days without much back-and-forth, that hour before television stretches out.
I saw your porch light on but not you. Are you still over at Ocean Breeze?
Just leaving. The spring fair board added two more tables, so I had to pencil in four people and leave three phone messages.
All right. I watered the basil. Your tote with the paperback stack is still by your door.
Perfect. Those are for Thursday morning, then I can put the tote away until next month.
Your porch light is on and I saw you close the slider. Do you want me to look from my side too?
Thank you, but I just tried the handle again and it held. I am turning off channel 6 and making tea.
Good. I have my flashlight on the counter if the rain gets heavier.
I checked the patio chair and the numbers on the cuff, so tea and the puzzle book now.
Aunt Katherine, if I send the kids' reading-list email, can you tell me which titles look right for Maya's project?
Send it over. I am at the branch from 9 until noon, so I may answer after the cart and hold shelf are done.
No rush. They asked for books by Latino, Caribbean, and Asian American writers, and I trust your eye.
I found three good ones near the March display and wrote the names carefully. I will send a photo after lunch.
Did you make it to that new Wednesday thing at the center?
I did. Mostly seated work, some breathing, and the instructor was fine with my hands resting instead of gripping.
That sounds sensible. Better than pushing through and then being sore for two days.
Exactly. I still want pickleball Friday if the joints behave, but I am not forcing it.
Aunt Katherine, Emily sent me the picture of your cake. Did they really fit all 76 candles on there?
They used number candles. Much safer, and easier on the frosting.
Aunt Katherine, that Facebook post you sent me is from a page that copies old headlines and changes the date. I would not share it.
Smart. She also said you had the old Cherry Hill High program out with the library photo. That scrapbook is getting serious.
Thank you. A woman at the center passed it around saying seniors would lose checks next month. It looked fishy but frightened people.
It is mostly labels now. I want Robert's children to know which pictures came before my first paycheck envelope.
You were right to ask. I can show you how to check the page history on Sunday.
Please. I am careful now. Too many older folks believe the first loud thing they see, especially about benefits and voting.
Are you still riding with me Sunday, or did Robert's call move again?
Still riding with you. I want to be there early enough to set out the little cups and the offering plates.
Good. I will park near the side entrance so your knees do not have to do those front steps.
Thank you. I also tucked the Cherry Hill recipe card into my purse for the luncheon signup.
Garden club is meeting at Mounts on Tuesday. Are you riding with me?
Not this time. I am staying close to home and using what is already in the cabinet.
All right. I can bring you the handout if they give one.
That would be nice. I will make beans with canned tomatoes and herbs, then finish the little quilt blocks without buying the batting yet.
Are you still going to the clubhouse room after supper? I saw the flyer by the mailboxes.
Yes, just the small reading circle. I am bringing the notes from that Sun Sentinel follow-up.
Good. I prefer those smaller rooms. People can actually hear each other.
Exactly. I learn more that way, especially after finishing the Men We Reaped chapters.
Morning. I put two school pictures in the shared album before work. One missing front tooth and one very serious soccer pose.
I saw them. The serious pose made me laugh. I saved both to the family folder.
They asked if you can do Sunday on Zoom instead of Saturday because Tampa has the spring fair.
Sunday works. I will keep the little album nearby so they can choose which old beach photo gets a label.
The kids' heritage night form asks for a few family places. Can I use Camden, Trenton, Maine, Pennsylvania, Cherry Hill, and Boynton Beach?
That is the honest list from my side. My travels are all inside the country too, so do not add anything fancy for me.
Got it. There is also a line for people who had uniforms and official papers. Should I leave your name off that part?
Yes, leave me off. Your grandpa belongs there if you want one Holder example.
Sunday call at 4 still works. Also, I saw your email about the city comment card.
Sunday at four still works. I found the envelope from Mama's dresser with the hospital parking passes in it.
Good. I am keeping my comment practical: clear written steps, cameras that actually stay on, and someone outside the department looking at serious complaints.
Keep it for now, please. The dates help me line up the notes, and I want that part written plainly.
I can read you the names on the forms if your eyes get tired. Some of the handwriting is awful.
That sounds fair. You are not going in with some dramatic personal story.
That would help. I will have the green notebook open beside the quilt blocks so I do not lose my place.
No. The most I have had is a warning years ago and a report after Elaine's car window was smashed. That is why I want rules that do not depend on who is standing there.
Aunt Katherine, I looked at the budget app screenshot. You can hide those old school categories if they are just empty placeholders.
Please do. The active list should just show the building, county, insurance, utilities, groceries, and Dr. Moreno.
Done. I left Dr. Moreno under monthly payments and moved the sink repair to home notes.
Thank you. That screen was making everything look busier than it is.
Aunt Katherine, that article you asked about was a screenshot from a private FB group. No source listed.
That is what bothered me. The Palm Beach County page said the spring clinic is for certain ages and to bring the card with prior dates.
I can send you the direct county link so you do not have to hunt through posts.
Please do. I will compare it with Dr. Singh's message before I book anything.
Aunt Katherine, I fixed the photo album link. Emily can add the soccer pictures now.
Thank you. I want the children to have the recipes, church picnic photos, and the old Cherry Hill names in one place.

Yes. That room is for family visits and my sewing table, not for anyone's extra furniture.
I left your mail on the hall table. The package from Joann was by the door.
Thank you. That should be the cream backing and more size 7 needles.
Your niece's room looked tidy when I passed by. I didn't touch anything.
I tucked the pastel tub under the bed and left the machine covered. Emily's bags can go by the closet.
Aunt Katherine, I found the folder you labeled for recipes and accounts. It is very clear.
I am relieved. I kept picturing you having to hunt for everything while juggling the kids' school emails.
We would manage, but the labels help. Did you ever use that card Dr. Sato gave you for someone to talk things through with?
Not yet. I put it by the phone. If the late-night spiraling gets worse, I would call.
Those pelicans were right by the bridge after you left. Bring the phone Monday if the weather holds!
I will. I want to try holding it lower instead of pointing straight into the glare.
Good plan. If one comes out clear, that would beat my muffin picture.
I already used the hibiscus this month, so I may just send the bird to you and Emily for now.
Senior center posted that the Tuesday lecture moved to Room B. I almost missed it!
I saw it after the church bake sale post. I put both in my paper calendar.
My niece says they put reminders in stories now too. I never remember where those are.
Same here. If it disappears after a day, it is not much help to me.
If I come down in April, should I bring the folding cot again?
No need. I cleared the back room after moving the recipe boxes to the closet.
Good. I remember the parking gate being fussy last time.
I will leave your pass on the hall table, beside the watering sheet for Elaine.
Aunt Katherine, did the TV guide app update work? You should see favorites on the left now.
It did. I pinned the South Florida basketball channel and the station with the black-and-white porch scenes.
Good. That should save you hunting around at night.
Exactly. If the game goes sideways, I know where to land before bed.
We may be ten minutes late today. Linda wants to stop at Publix after lunch.
No trouble. I will keep the ringer on after four.
Good. It is warm in Jacksonville today, so I am staying out of the garage until evening.
Then we can compare weather and groceries when you are back.
Before the game starts, did you still want me to look at St. Augustine hotels near the old streets?
Yes, but no rush. The Miami day may come first if Emily can spare a Saturday.
Miami meaning the house on Biscayne Bay or the Fairchild stop?
Both if it is not too much, though I would rather start where there are trees and benches.
How are you doing, Aunt Katherine? Did the bank app sign you out again?
It did, but I got back in and saw the same balance as this morning. I also refreshed the weather app twice and then stopped.
Good. The app will show the same thing unless something posts overnight.
That helps. The remote is on PBS now, so I am leaving the phone on the charger.
I did not see your blinds open today. Everything all right next door?
All right. I skipped clubhouse and kept the afternoon for reading. Dinner is done now, so I may step onto the porch.
I am taking recycling down at 7:40. I can stop by your railing for a minute.
That would be nice. Tomorrow is Marlene, and Friday is Emily on video, so tonight just needs a small wave.
Short loop today? Humidity is already rude.
Good walk today. Are you still going across the state this weekend?
Short loop, then coffee. I want to ask if you saved that article about the library hours and the school board item.
Maybe. I put the last $12 from coffee change into my little road sleeve, so I am close.
Take the easier route if you go. That bridge construction sounded annoying.
I have it in my tote. You and that blue folder!
It is full again. County pages, clippings, and a few notes for the next packet, whenever they send it.
I will only go if the forecast stays clear and my knee is calm by Friday.
I am going to the clubhouse copier after breakfast. Need anything copied?
Maybe one page from the March bank printout, just the line where the monthly money came in.
Sure. Bring it over. I can black out the account number for you.
Thanks. The tax folder is finally tidy: bank page, two government letters, and the Vanguard sheet. No time sheets or office envelopes to chase.
Are you using the 8 by 8 dish tonight? I can return yours before supper.
Keep it until morning. Mine is already in the oven with noodles and a thin sauce.
Thank you. Do you want the small foil pans I bought at Publix?
Yes please. I can tuck away two servings and not cook again tomorrow.
Can we move Sunday call to 4:30? Dolphins replay starts at 3.
4:30 is fine. I will be back from Publix by then. They texted that both refills are ready.
Good. Did Patel change anything after the numbers you mailed?
One tablet moved to morning. I am keeping the fried foods to once a week and reading the new stapled sheet before I put the bottle away.
Daniel, can I send you a screenshot? The branch post keeps cutting off the bottom of Saturday's flyer.
Sure, Aunt Katherine. Is it on Facebook or in email?
Facebook. I can still find a misplaced hold faster than I can fix a cropped flyer.
Send it. If it is the one with the three writers' photos, I can resize it for you.
Aunt Katherine, the school district 403b rep is coming Friday and everyone is asking what to pick. My head hurts.
I never chase the shiny choices. I keep the boring bank bucket where I can reach it, and the little Vanguard piece just sits.
That is probably healthier than me reading every chart at midnight.
Charts can wait. Make sure your regular bills could sit there for a while first, then choose what lets you sleep.
Aunt Katherine, I got the photo. Is that the same little tree you moved before the last windy night?
Yes. Elaine helped me slide it closer to the wall. The roses are in the picture too, just cut off.
Looks good. Also, the picture sent sideways because your phone rotation lock is on.
That explains it. I was trying to show Emily the basil before I cut some for supper.
Aunt Katherine, did the spreadsheet open on your laptop?
Yes, thank you. I entered the March names and the total comes to 11.5 hours for me this week.
Good. Put the file in the folder I made so it backs up. Same place as the photos.
Done. After Monday's walk sheet and Thursday's book room list, I only have the card prizes left to count.
Back in Atlanta. Just checking you got home from errands before dark.
Yes, groceries are put away. Emily sent a note that the children want the banana bread story again.
That tracks. Also your phone should remember the FaceTime setting now, so you should not have to tap around next time.
Thank you. I wrote your steps on the pad by the charger.
How are you doing, Aunt Katherine? Did the phone bill link open right?
It opened, thank you. I paid that and the dentist balance, so the mall trip can wait.
Got it. Need me to order anything online for you?
No order now. I patched the heel liner with moleskin and made rice with tuna instead of picking up supper.
Aunt Katherine, Mom said you mailed something soft for the baby shower. Need me to help track it?
If you can check USPS, yes please. It is the yellow crib-size piece from the sunshine bin, wrapped in tissue.
Tracking says Jacksonville tomorrow by 9pm.
Perfect. I kept the matching leftover squares in the labeled tub so I can make a little pillow later.
The office put the April coupon slips by the mailboxes. Yours is still in the tray.
Thanks. I will grab it after breakfast and put it with the insurance notice and Marco's sink receipt.
Good. I am doing mine today too before I forget.
Your yellow orchid opened this morning. The light is soft before the sun hits the railing.
Thank you. I took a few and will compare them with the quilt picture from yesterday.
The quilt colors may show better on the porch table. No rush.
Maybe one of those will go up with Robert's birthday message next week, if I can get it straight.
I saw your car gone early again. Did you and Marlene beat the rain?
Just barely. She called from the parking lot when I was still tying my sneakers.
Good timing. I left your porch plant where it will not get soaked.
Thank you. Marlene and I are drying off with coffee before I head back.
The clubhouse board posted that insurance letter again. Did you see it?
I picked up a copy. I put it behind the condo statement so I can look at both before April starts.
Good idea. I am doing mine tomorrow with a cup of tea.
Tea helps. I already paid the end-of-month pharmacy charge, so the folder is down to groceries and whatever that letter means.
Our school newsletter says the board packet has book complaints again. I thought of you because you always ask what the kids can actually read.
Send it when you can. Schools and libraries should not be treated like campaign props.
Will do. Also the civics teacher asked families to remind students their mock vote needs a reason, not just a slogan.
Good for that teacher. When I was younger I split my choices more often, but these days I look first at who protects schools, accepts the count, and talks like a decent adult.
The kids voted for your lemon chicken card for Easter. Can you write the oven temp big? Last time I guessed.
I will copy it neatly and add Grandma Rose's name at the top so they know whose table it came from.
Love that. Also my school volunteer asked me about a Medicare form today and I thought of your calm little arrows.
Those arrows save trouble. Tell her to bring every page and not be embarrassed by the small print.
I added the science fair album where you usually see the kids' pictures. Maya is holding the volcano sign.
Found it. That place makes sense to me because all the family names are right there.
I put one short video on Insta too, but I can text it if that is easier.
Text it, please. I open that one by accident and then cannot find my way back to the children.
Humidity is already thick. Short loop and coffee?
Short loop sounds right. I was up at 3 looking at the storm map, then the Medicare premium chart, then my pulse notes.
Humidity is low for once. Full loop at 7:30, then coffee?
Full loop sounds fine. I have to mail Emily copies of those Cherry Hill pictures afterward.
Bring the notebook if you want. We can split a muffin and put the papers in order.
The church basement ones with the long tables?
Those, and the 2014 list I made before choosing this condo. I had forgotten how many columns I drew.
Thanks. No pill bottle to pick up, at least. Just the notebook and that card Dr. Sato said I could use later.
Short loop this morning? The air is already soup. You can tell me what Doris picked for May.
Short loop is fine. Doris is leaning toward that new one about nurses in Vietnam, but I am still hoping they keep Viola Davis on the list.
Bring your little paper list to coffee. I like hearing which ones make everybody talk.
I tucked it in my canvas bag with the library receipt.
Can we move Sunday call to 4:30? Dolphins replay is on earlier.
4:30 is fine. I may tell you about the library panel if we have time.
Sure. Linda said you mailed her that article from the Post.
I did. It went with my notes from The Yellow House. Easier to talk through slowly on the phone.
Can we move Sunday to 3:30? Dolphins replay starts at 4.
3:30 is fine. I put it on the kitchen calendar and left the phone charger beside the chair.
Thanks. Emily said the school bake table is still short two people next week.
Tell her I can take one of the early boxes if she sends the page with the times. I do better when I can see where my name goes.
Kids asked if Aunt Katherine wants ocean or old buildings for the summer drive. They remember you mentioning Key West once.
Maybe someday again, but not in the hottest part. St. Augustine might be easier for all of us.
If we do Miami instead, I can get us there early before the sun is harsh.
Early would be best. I keep picturing palms, flowers, and a quiet bench before lunch.

Maybe: everyone knows the rules ahead of time, the video is saved, and the people checking the complaint are not the same ones being complained about.
That is clear. She asked if you ever had a scary story from that.
Tell her no, not personally. But I have sat beside women at the clubhouse who carry very different stories for their boys, so I try to listen before talking.
Did you still want me to save the kids' book fair receipts for you when we come down?
Yes, tuck them in an envelope. I will sort them with mine when April starts.
You and your neat stacks. I wish my kitchen counter looked that calm.
It only looks calm after I copy everything from the register to the monthly page.
Kids are finishing homework. Want us to FaceTime before baths?
Yes, now is better. I looked once more at the door and the forecast, and I want the television changed before seven.
Calling in two minutes. Maya wants to show you her spelling medal :)
Lovely. I have the blue blanket, cuff put away, and the home channel on.
